verdict.rationale: Docs mention a 'Playground' for creating tokens with pre-filled parameters (skyfire-docs-2) and structured reference pages for each API call (skyfire-docs-4, skyfire-docs-5), suggesting some interactive testing exists, but there is no evidence of a full interactive API reference (e.g., embedded runnable code snippets, live console, or OpenAPI-based try-it-now UI) — the openapi probe returned 404s (skyfire-probe-2), indicating no discoverable machine-readable spec to power such a reference. missing for 10: explicit interactive API console/reference UI, confirmation that Playground covers all endpoints, and any hands-on corroboration of runnable examples.
